subject: Rebook request: Preference for 20m demo on Jul 2 (signalytics)
body:
From: Alex Greene <alex.green@signalytics.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Need to reschedule tomorrow's demo

Hi Sofia,

Quick heads up — something came up on our side and we won't be able to make the demo slot we booked for tomorrow afternoon. Really sorry for the short notice. Can we please reschedule? Our team is tight on calendar this week but we can do short deep dives. Here are a few windows that would work for us (all PT):

- Thu Jul 2, 09:00 - 09:20
- Thu Jul 2, 09:30 - 09:50
- Thu Jul 2, 11:00 - 11:20

If none of those work, we can push to next week but we'd prefer to keep it brief (20m) — just a focused tech walk-through and a couple of Qs. Apologies again; appreciate any flexibility.

Best,
Alex Greene
Head of Data & ML
Signalytics

---
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Greene <alex.green@signalytics.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need to reschedule tomorrow's demo

Thanks for the update, Alex — totally understand. We can absolutely do a focused 20m deep dive.

I'm proposing three tight options (PT) based on our engineer availability — please reply with a single digit to confirm: 1 / 2 / 3. We'll lock the calendar immediately once you confirm.

1) Thu Jul 2 — 09:00 - 09:20 (PT)
2) Thu Jul 2 — 09:30 - 09:50 (PT)
3) Thu Jul 2 — 11:00 - 11:20 (PT)

Agenda (20m):
- 0–2m: quick intros and goal for this session
- 2–14m: focused demo (prefix caching, routing policy example for logs-to-embeddings workflow)
- 14–18m: Qs on integration/latency expectations
- 18–20m: next steps & owners

I've attached a short pre-demo checklist and a CSV with the proposed times so it's easy to accept. If you'd like Marissa (product eng) on the call, please say so and we'll include her.

Thanks — Sofia
Sofia Ivanova | Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: proposed_times.csv, pre-demo_checklist.docx

---
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.ai>, Alex Greene <alex.green@signalytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 17:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Need to reschedule tomorrow's demo

+1 to Sofia's slots — I can cover 09:00 (option 1) but would prefer we tighten to 09:00–09:20 exactly to respect the customer's ask for a brief run-through.

Marissa — can you join if Alex picks 09:00? If not, we can do a 09:30 slot and schedule a follow-up with engineering.

Notes for the run:
- Keep the demo focused on integration touchpoints (API keys, routing policies) and a single end-to-end example (embedding + rerank).
- Have the quick cost/latency numbers ready for a 1k token prompt.
- I'll send the calendar invite with a 20m duration; please hold that buffer.

Ben Carter
Sales Engineering (on-call) | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Hi Sofia — thanks for being flexible.

We'll take option 1 but need to shift the start by 15 minutes on our side — can we do 09:15–09:35 (PT) instead of 09:00–09:20? Still a 20m slot, just offset. If that won't work for Ben or Marissa let us know and we can take 09:30.

Also, please include the 20m agenda in the invite and a short dial-in + meeting link. That helps us lock it in quickly.

Appreciate it — Alex

- Dial-in: https://meet.google.com/rwd-demo
